# LightWebPres

> LightWebPres is a single-file Python publisher that turns Markdown into self-contained HTML articles and presentations, with portrait reading, landscape navigation, optional long-form content and a series index.

Status: **Beta**. The website package identifies its engine as **0.56.0, unreleased**. Match documentation to the chosen source or release rather than treating the website build as the latest stable version.

Use the CLI for unattended builds, strict audits, output verification and watch workflows. Identity, preset and theme are separate appearance concepts; self-contained Identity Kits can provide their own layouts, chrome and assets. The included Pyodide browser builder runs the same engine and requires HTTP(S). It is distinct from the separate `lightwebpres-gui` editor. The format skill describes syntax; the optional sourced-presentation skill describes an editorial method.

Trusted sources only: raw HTML and scripts can pass through. Speaker notes are published in the HTML; tags are not access controls. Deleting source files does not automatically remove stale output. The engine's GPL license and Output Exception distinguish the generator from normal generated presentations.

## Try and explore

- [Full product portal](https://fadeshed.github.io/lightwebpres/): six paths through reading, authoring, appearance and publishing; the supplied portal is in French.
- [Interactive example](https://fadeshed.github.io/lightwebpres/demo/ma-page.html): one document to read in portrait or present in landscape.
- [Rendered guide](https://fadeshed.github.io/lightwebpres/guide/guide.html): full operational manual as a LightWebPres document.
- [Theme gallery](https://fadeshed.github.io/lightwebpres/themes.html): inspect built-in themes in rendered examples.
- [Browser builder](https://fadeshed.github.io/lightwebpres/web/): build a series in a tab with the bundled engine and local Pyodide assets; HTTP(S) required.

## Start here

- [Product overview](https://fadeshed.github.io/lightwebpres/index.md): publishing model, authoring interfaces, agent use, licensing and trust boundaries.
- [Operational guide](https://fadeshed.github.io/lightwebpres/reference/GUIDE.md): create a series, author articles, choose appearance, build, verify and publish.
- [Format skill](https://fadeshed.github.io/lightwebpres/reference/agent/skills/lightwebpres/SKILL.md): exact article grammar for people and agents.
- [Glossary](https://fadeshed.github.io/lightwebpres/reference/GLOSSARY.md): fields, defaults and fallback behavior.

## Optional

- [Specification](https://fadeshed.github.io/lightwebpres/reference/specifications.md): detailed format and behavior reference in French.
- [Editorial method](https://fadeshed.github.io/lightwebpres/reference/agent/skills/sourced-presentation/SKILL.md): optional source-grounded presentation workflow, separate from the renderer.
- [Contributor guide](https://fadeshed.github.io/lightwebpres/reference/AGENTS.md): source layout, tests and contribution rules.
